result_text:
The per-rep purchase order count now leaves out cancelled purchase orders, so your example gives Anna 2 and Bob 1.

The change is in `findPurchaseOrderCountPerSalesRep` in `src/main/java/com/acme/backoffice/DataStorePart07.java`. It adds `po.status <> 'CANCELLED'` to the subquery, the same filter the other per-rep counts and the quarter and latest purchase-order reports use. I also updated its Javadoc to say cancelled orders are not counted.

In `src/test/java/com/acme/backoffice/SalesRepPurchaseOrderCountTest.java` I added `cancelledPurchaseOrdersAreNotCounted`, which reproduces your example. The helper `purchaseOrder` now takes an optional status and defaults to SENT, so the existing calls are unchanged.

`SalesRepPurchaseOrderCountTest` passes (4 tests), and so do `SalesRepOrderCountTest`, `QuarterPurchaseOrdersTest` and `LatestPurchaseOrdersTest`. Nothing is committed.
